items.title: Intel (INTC) Faces Lawsuit And AI Selloff As Fair Value Debate Gets Harder
items.summary: Intel (INTC) is under pressure after a sector-wide selloff in semiconductor and AI stocks coincided with a new class action lawsuit accusing the company of misleading disclosures about its slowing PC business and AI positioning.
